name: AIDLC-kb
description: Reverse-engineering knowledge-base builder: turns a corpus (RED, specs, schema dumps, source) into typed, cited knowledge cards (ENT/BR/FR/SCR/WF/CMP/API), a typed-edge graph (graph.json) and an evidence map, in the layout fe_core.kb.cards reads. Deterministic gate script validates ids, edges and evidence before the KB is used by downstream stages.

author.name: AIG AI COE Tech Mod Team
